title: Which guidance applies to Downgrading Your Plan?

question.author: member_035
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of downgrading your plan. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: Files above the new quota become read-only/download-only for 90 days, and new uploads are blocked. Shared links to over-quota content remain live during those 90 days but only allow viewing and downloading — no uploads through links. After 90 days, over-quota files are moved to the recycle bin and those shared links expire. To keep everything, either free up space or upgrade again within the 90-day window. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
